title: GRADE Working Group: evidence-certainty and recommendation-strength translation rail
summary: Promotes GRADE Working Group: evidence-certainty and recommendation-strength translation rail as a de-adoption/practice-lag infrastructure record. The record is not an incident or trial record; it describes a rail by which negative evidence can become reviewable, discussable, recommended against, or translated into practice constraints.

claims.claim: GRADE is encoded as a translation rail because de-adoption depends not just on whether a trial was negative, but on how certain the evidence is and how strong a recommendation should be.

evidence_profile.source_depth: one-pass source-backed extraction; child record and second-pass systematic-review extraction required for mature synthesis
limitations: Not medical advice and not a current clinical recommendation engine.
Uses exact indication/population/endpoints available in one-pass sources; child records needed for all subgroups and guideline dates.
Practice-lag claims require fuller utilization and reimbursement child records before maturity.
requires underlying systematic review and stakeholder values
type_payload.query_value: A method rail for preventing negative results from being translated too strongly, too weakly, or without explicit certainty.

handling_notes: Clinical reversals can involve real patients who made choices under uncertainty; avoid hindsight contempt.
Do not treat procedure de-adoption as a patient-specific treatment recommendation.
Preserve the difference between “no benefit in studied population” and “never useful.”

revision_history.action: structural audit backfill: added unknowns/next_actions without changing factual claims or status

revision_history.change: Claim support migrated to typed evidence_refs; factual claim text and statuses unchanged.

unknowns: The record does not yet encode a versioned GRADE handbook or detailed certainty-downgrade examples.
Discipline-specific variants and local implementations are not mapped.
How recommendation strength actually changes practice is not captured here.
next_actions: Extract a small set of GRADE examples showing high-to-low certainty transitions and strong/weak recommendation differences.
Link GRADE use to medical-reversal and guideline records only when explicit guideline documents are sourced.
Add a vocabulary bridge between GRADE certainty and cube claim-status fields.
